name: Discovery Observation Visibility Rules
description: Configuration for which observations may become participant-facing.

visibilityStates.name: Private Observation
visibilityStates.description: An internal, tentative observation used to guide curiosity but not ready for participant-facing reflection.
visibilityStates.requirements: May have thin, partial, ambiguous, or unsupported evidence.

visibilityStates.name: Provisional Observation
visibilityStates.description: A tentative observation with some evidence that may guide exploration or invite clarification.
visibilityStates.requirements: At least one participant statement, example, or traceable signal.
visibilityStates.participantFacingEligibility: Participant-facing only with tentative language and validation invitation.

visibilityStates.name: Reflection Eligible Observation
visibilityStates.description: An observation supported enough to be reflected for participant correction, refinement, or confirmation.
visibilityStates.requirements: Concrete evidence, repeated signal, participant language, or meaningful participant context.

visibilityStates.name: Participant Confirmed Theme
visibilityStates.description: A theme the participant has confirmed, corrected into their own language, or explicitly accepted.
visibilityStates.requirements: Participant confirmation, correction, refinement, or clear resonance.
visibilityStates.participantFacingEligibility: Participant-facing when attributed to participant confirmation.

guardrails: Unsupported observations should not automatically appear in participant-facing reflections.
Private observations may guide curiosity but should not be stated as insight.
Reflection eligible observations must remain correctable.
Participant confirmed themes remain revisable if the participant later reframes them.
